claim: A partition placement group can have partitions in multiple Availability Zones of the same Region, and it offers visibility into the partitions, so you can see which instances are in which partitions and share this information with topology-aware applications such as HDFS, HBase and Cassandra.

evidence.quote: A partition placement group can have partitions in multiple Availability Zones in the same Region.

In addition, partition placement groups offer visibility into the partitions—you can see which instances are in which partitions. You can share this information with topology-aware applications, such as HDFS, HBase, and Cassandra.
